name: Utah

jury_list.holder: Administrative Office of the Courts (master jury list, Utah Code 78B-1-106).

voter_file.who_may_get: Utah Code 20A-2-607(3) (2026): a person may only obtain or use the voter list for a political purpose, a purpose expressly permitted by Part 6, or a purpose permitted by other law or court order.
voter_file.permitted_uses: Political purpose or another expressly permitted purpose (20A-2-607(3)). Obtaining it under false pretenses or using it for another purpose is unlawful (20A-2-607(4)).
voter_file.penalty: Class A misdemeanor (20A-2-607(5)), including knowingly posting the list or its information on the internet or disclosing it to the public (20A-2-607(4)(c)).

private_challenge.form_or_statute: Utah Code 20A-3a-804: written statement to the election officer naming each challenged individual, the ground under 20A-3a-803 (ground (1)(c): 'not a citizen of the United States'), supporting facts, and a signed affidavit under penalty of perjury.
private_challenge.deadlines: At least 45 calendar days before the election (for voters registered later, up to election day) (20A-3a-804(1)(b)). The officer notifies the voter at least 28 days before the election.
private_challenge.evidence_standard: Affidavit that the filer 'exercised due diligence to personally verify the facts and circumstances' and that the basis is valid 'according to the filer's personal knowledge and belief'; no 'unsupported allegations or allegations by an anonymous individual' (20A-3a-804(1)).
private_challenge.false_statement_penalty: Affidavit subject to penalties of perjury (20A-3a-804(1)(a)(iii)).

state_windows.applies_to: Pre-election written challenges under Utah Code 20A-3a-804
state_windows.effect: Challenges must be filed at least 45 days before the election (except for late registrants).

gates.basis: Jury record status unknown (null): counts only. Utah limits voter-list use to political and other expressly permitted purposes (20A-2-607), and a private challenge needs personal verification (20A-3a-804).

notes: Use limit: JuryRoll matching may not be a 'political purpose' under 20A-2-607(3). The app should warn Utah users before loading a voter file.
Utah allows several challenged individuals in one statement (one_per_affidavit false), but each needs its own facts and personal verification.

Source note: le.utah.gov sends no intermediate certificate. On 2026-10-07, 20A-2-607 (effective 3/18/2026), 20A-3a-803, 20A-3a-804 and 78B-1-106 were re-fetched with TLS verification on. The chain was completed with Sectigo's OV R36 intermediate and verified to a system root. The text matches every value in this file.
